name: Spatial 2D hidden-state demonstration v0.1
claim: Test whether physically reached, similar current observations retain different future responses and how short classical history changes spatial prediction; do not assert long-history or control necessity.
unit_of_analysis: Complete synthetic parent loading history, conditional on fixed material/geometry. All windows, future branches and shared-noise realizations are dependent within that parent. Real object or mechanism transfer is not tested.

datasets.name: Archived history dependence
datasets.role: Separate display-pipeline replay; no new spatial evidence

datasets.name: New spatial 2D
datasets.role: Synthetic FEM traces, full internal fields privileged for diagnosis/reference

splits.name: calibration
splits.leakage_check: No shared parent with validation/test; numerical main episode separate

splits.name: validation
splits.held_out: Two parents 200-201 plus fixed smooth/pulse sweep parents
splits.leakage_check: Window and noise diagnosis kept separate from test comparisons; no fitting to test truth

splits.name: test
splits.leakage_check: All branches stay with the parent; pair selected by current sensors before future computation; all pairs logged

baselines.name: Short classical
controlled_variables: longer history is the information intervention

baselines.name: Full classical
controlled_variables: known relaxed start explicitly additional information

baselines.name: True state
controlled_variables: full internal fields and exact current tool state are privileged

metrics.name: Per-parent force RMSE in N
metrics.rationale: Prediction over one second including approach/contact; paired action conditions remain grouped

metrics.name: Lateral RMSE in m
metrics.rationale: Independent output type from solved deformation, two symmetric markers not independent modes

metrics.name: Matching residual/acceptance rate
metrics.rationale: State similarity using all current deployment channels; not exact observation equality

metrics.name: Physics errors and constraint overruns
metrics.rationale: Whole prefixes and futures audited; no discarded solver/constraint failures

metrics.name: Inference seconds and solver evaluations
metrics.rationale: Different window costs and algorithmic budgets disclosed

ablations: Synthetic noise 0 and 1; 4 available on demand
falsification_criteria: No resolved future contrast after current-sensor matching and numerical refinement: no aliasing evidence for this regime
Snapshot explains contrast using residual lateral information: similarity alone does not establish hidden-state necessity
Short classical is sufficiently accurate: do not claim a long sequence or neural state is necessary
Nominal noise reverses the short-window advantage: retain the failure and diagnose observability/model-fit conditioning
Physics gate fails: retain and diagnose before interpreting method differences
No action comparison executed: prediction improvement cannot support decision benefit

compute_budget.statistical_scope: small exploratory pilot; no powered hypothesis test
compute_budget.stop_rule: fixed listed parents, conditions and windows; no future-effect-based case selection

limitations: 5 um matching band is not sensor quantization
One common sensor-noise realization per condition
No recursive learning, controller gain study, 3D arm, real measurement, or universal sufficiency proof

framework_mapping.D1: five sensor channels plus command and time
framework_mapping.mechanism_link: D1 x C1 x two internal strain fields x feasible loading/future intervention x M1 x relevance/history/cross-action prediction; decision and transfer levels remain untested
